notes: pointycastle 3.9.1's actual installed source was read directly from the pub-cache before writing any code — confirmed OAEPEncoding has no 3-arg (engine, digest, mgf1Digest) constructor and unconditionally sets mgf1Hash = hash in init(), so OAEPEncoding.withSHA256(RSAEngine()) is both correct and structurally immune to the MGF1/digest-mismatch pitfall the original research flagged for other pointycastle usages. This correction was written into phase-03's Design Constraints before implementation.

Tester's RSA-2048 public key fixture in encryption_helper_test.dart was verified with `openssl pkey -pubin -inform DER -noout -text` before trusting it — confirmed real (unlike a Phase 1 tester run that fabricated an invalid PEM fixture).

SyncEngine's new EncryptionHelper dependency was made optional (default EncryptionHelper()) to match its existing constructor convention (createPeriodicTimer/logger/backoff are all optional with defaults) — this kept every pre-existing SyncEngine(...) call site in sync_engine_test.dart compiling unchanged.

AttemptTaskResponse gets encryptionPublicKey but no separate answerIntegrityLevel field — the server only ever sends a non-null key for STRICT attempts, so its presence alone is the client's routing signal.
